fusions.name: Ricochet Pellet
fusions.desc: Flicks a pellet that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, then bounces on to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 70% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Long Hop Landing
fusions.desc: Leaps you to a target up to 7 tiles away and bites it, dealing 13 damage and leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Its damage rises 6% for every 100 paces you have travelled since you last used it (max 30%).

fusions.name: Gone in a Hop
fusions.desc: Springs you instantly to a point up to 6 tiles away. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Next Host Waiting
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, your next strike has 15% more critical hit chance. Once every 8 seconds.
